checks.name: TIA Portal installation
checks.message: TIA Portal V21 installation was not found in any inspected location.
checks.remediation: Install TIA Portal V21, set TiaPortalV21Dir to its PublicAPI\V21\net48 folder, or set TiaPortalLocation to the Portal V21 installation root.

checks.name: Openness assemblies
checks.message: No TIA Portal V21 installation was found.
checks.remediation: Install TIA Portal V21 with the Openness option, or set TiaPortalV21Dir to the PublicAPI\V21\net48 folder.

checks.name: Siemens TIA Openness group
checks.message: The local group "Siemens TIA Openness" does not exist.
checks.remediation: Install TIA Portal V21 with the Openness option to create the group, then add the current user to it and sign out and sign in again.

checks.name: TIA Portal process
checks.message: No running TIA Portal instance was detected.
checks.remediation: Start TIA Portal V21 before operations that attach to an open project. This is informational; the installation can still be valid.

checks.name: Project binding
checks.message: No project binding is configured. Project tools fail until bind_project binds an already-open project.
checks.remediation: Call bind_project with the intended already-open project's absolute projectPath, or set --project to its path, or set TIA_MCP_PROJECT_PATH.
